name: Haotian Wu
description: Haotian Wu: robotics, AI products, investment research and selected projects.
intro: My background is in mechanical engineering and robotics. I have worked on robotics algorithms, cloud computing and AI products, alongside investment and industry research.
I currently lead algorithms and software at 腰果智能, a consumer hardware startup. My interests include AI agents, AI for Science, and applications of AI in games and consumer hardware.
This site collects my projects, research and professional experience.
